Nearest City: Belton, SC
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: NICKEL SULFARMATE
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: B&B PLATING CO,
Skytruth Analysis
POLICE RESPONDED TO BURGLAR ALARM AND DISCOVERED HEAVY SMOKE COMING FROM BUILDING. BELTON FIRE DEPT. RESPONDED TO FIND HEAVY FIRE INVOLVING METAL PLATING SOLUTIONS IN DIP TANKS AND ASSOCIATED PIPING. PLATING SOLUTIONS INVOLVED WERE NICKEL SULFARMATE AND SULFURIC ACID (7%). FIRE DEPARTMENT EXTINGUISHED FIRE. MIXTURE OF PLATING SOLUTION AND FIRE FIGHTING WATER COVERED FLOOR OF APPROX. HALF OF THE STRUCTURE AND RAN OUT DOOR OPENINGS. ANDERSON COUNTY HAZMAT PERSONNEL CONTAINED RUNOFF TO ASPHALT APRON AROUND THE BUILDING AND A LOADING DOCK RAMP. NO PRODUCT EXTENDED BEYOND THE PROPERTY LINE. FD PERSONNEL WERE DECONED. SC DHEC WAS NOTIFIED AND A REPRESENTATIVE RESPONDED TO THE SCENE.

Report Description///THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT NUMBER 1361510. THE UPDATE IS THEY HAVE CONFIRMED A CATASTROPHIC FAILURE OF A HIGH VOLTAGE TRANSFORMER WHERE THE POWER ENTERS THE MILL CREEK TREATMENT PLANT. A BACK UP TRANSFORMER IS BEING BUILT IN CALIFORNIA AND WONT BE ON SITE FOR AT LEAST TWO WEEKS THEN SEVERAL MORE WEEKS NEEDED TO ASSEMBLE AND TEST. THE OLD FEED WILL HAVE TO BE REBUILT IN ORDER TO RESTORE POWER TO THE PLANT, THIS USUALLY TAKES ONE TO TWO WEEKS. IN THE MEANTIME GENERATORS ARE BEING PLACED ON SITE WITH HE GOAL OF GETTING 130 MGD THROUGH PRIMARY TREATMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND KEEPING TREATMENT BIOLOGY ALIVE UNTIL SECONDARY TREATMENT CAN BEGIN. A GENERATOR ARRIVED MID AFTERNOON THAT WILL POWER THE MAIN SUPPORT BUILDINGS AND THEY EXPECT TO HAVE ENOUGH CAPACITY ON SITE TOMORROW TO GET PRIMARY TREATMENT RUNNING. ASSESSMENT OF HOW MUCH OF THE CREEK IS BEING AFFECTED BY CSO"S WILL TAKE PLACE TOMORROW. THEY HAVE RELEASED A PRESS RELEASE THAT RECCOMMENDS RECREATION ON THE MILL CREEK AND OHIO RIVER DOWN STREAM OF CINCINNATTI BE AVOIDED./// ///ORIGINAL// THE CALLER STATED THAT A WASTEWATER TREATMENT PLANT LOST POWER DUE TO A BLOWN TRANSFORMER. BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT THE PLANT IS UNABLE TO TREAT ANY WATER, DUE TO THE THE PLANT BEING BYPASSED. THERE IS AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF RAW SEWAGE RELEASING INTO THE MILL CREEK AND THE OHIO RIVER BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT.

THERE ARE NO FISH FATALITIES OBSERVED AND THE DIESEL DOES NOT APPEAR TO HAVE REACHED THE WATERWAY, IT IS SITTING ON THE SURFACE OF THE POND.
